newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Dec crude palm oil output down 16.35 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Dec crude palm oil output down 16.35 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's crude palm oil output fell 16.35 percent to 637,865 tonnes in December from 762,539 in November and against 654,998 in December 1995, the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) said on Wednesday.
December palm oil exports were 637,899 tonnes against 636,554 in November and 497,841 in December 1995, it said.
PORLA said Peninsular Malaysia's crude palm oil output fell 17.63 percent to 462,658 tonnes in December from 561,713 in November and 490,470 in December 1995.
Output from east Malaysian states of Sabah and Sarawak fell 12.76 percent to 175,207 tonnes in December from 200,826 in November and against 164,528 in December 1995.
Malaysia's palm kernel oil production fell 5.19 percent to 98,712 tonnes in December from 104,118 in November and against 99,769 in December 1995.
